topics.topic: How an empty file-list port is represented when no StoredValuesRef is present
questions: Must an empty input file list name its port with a StoredValuesRef, or is the absence of such a ref the representation of that named port?
Must every expected output port be named by a StoredValuesRef, with an unnamed port failing presence, or must an unnamed output port be interpreted as an expected empty file list?

quotes: A trial case therefore names exactly the contract's input ports, and expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.

MUST call read_records only with at least one identity, made only when there is a value_id to name, since read_records refuses an empty identity list as malformed: an input or an expected output of a file list with no files names no StoredValuesRef, so it is read with no call — the input's payload is a FileListPayload with no contents and the expected output's digests are the empty list —, and an expected file list with no files matches an output file list with no files.

When the case has expected outputs, they MUST be compared per output port of the contract version, never per port the refs happen to name: an output port that no expected StoredValuesRef names is an expected file list with no files.
judgement.why: The validation rule requires every input and present expected-output port to be named, while the added behavior requires an empty file-list port to have no StoredValuesRef and treats an unnamed expected port as an empty file list.

topics.topic: Whether an empty SpooledFilesRef must call read_records or perform no read
questions: Must an empty SpooledFilesRef call read_records as the first passage requires, or make no read as the second passage requires?

Must the FIELD_PROJECTION rule be qualified so that a SpooledFilesRef reads with read_records only when its files tuple is nonempty, or must the new BEHAVIOR rule permit an empty SpooledFilesRef read?

quotes: MUST call read_records only when a PortRef names at least one item, since read_records refuses an empty identity list as malformed: a SpooledFilesRef whose files are empty, a file list with no files, becomes a ShownPort with the same port name and no ShownItem, and makes no read.
judgement.why: The new behavior rule explicitly qualifies the general field-projection rule and requires no read for an empty SpooledFilesRef.
